text:
sara: Heads-up — we're getting customer escalations (acct: stripe-enterprise) about p99 spikes since runtime v2.3.0 rolled canary this morning. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/latency?svc=runtime shows p99 from ~180ms -> ~540ms around 09:12 UTC. Anyone oncall?

submit-bot: deploy completed: runtime v2.3.0 canary on cluster-us-east-1 at 2026-03-17T09:05:12Z by arjun

arjun: seeing it. canary is at 5% ingress. should we pause/rollback the canary?

sara: canary at 5%, autoswap to 0% didn't trigger automatically. customers are seeing long tails and some retries.

maria: grabbed traces for the customer — spike correlates with requests hitting the GPU-optimized path after kernel-selector heuristics changed. Traces show queuing before tokenize and long tails on KV cache misses. sample traces: trace-ff12, trace-ab34

lee: kernel-selector heuristic and batching tweaks were both in v2.3.0 (PR #389 + #392). batching heuristic reduced max_batch_size for low-latency traffic — could be creating backpressure and head-of-line blocking.

ops-oncall: quick repro we run from perf box:

```
# reproducer (perf box)
w rk -t12 -c200 -d60s -s scripts/gen_long_ctx.lua http://runtime-canary.internal/v1/generate
```

Run with 200 concurrent sessions and long context to amplify KV cache misses — p99 jumps locally to ~450-600ms.

maria: logs snippet around 09:11: `runtime.queue.len=72` and worker metric `alloc_wait=1.2s`. KV cache miss ratio increased to ~0.33 for affected requests. Also saw more frequent `kernel_select(path=gpu_high_mem)` decisions.

ben: plan: 1) rollback kernel-selector heuristic (safe, minimal surface) 2) if no improvement, revert batching heuristic 3) if still bad, check allocator changes. we'll bisect between those three.

arjun: started canary rollback to v2.2.7 at 09:20 UTC. monitoring metrics now.

sara: @maria — please collect top-100 traces & query samples. @ops-oncall — add a temporary pager if canary p99 > 300ms for >5m.

ops-oncall: runbook updated and alert created. paging rule: p99>300ms sustained 5m -> oncall page.

maria: mitigation applied for affected customer: enabled prefix-KV sticky cache for stripe-enterprise (toggle). Their p99 dropped to ~160ms immediately. :thumbsup:

arjun: rollback completed at 09:28 UTC; dashboard shows p99 back to baseline ~170ms on canary cluster. looks like the kernel-selector change is the culprit.

lee: opening ENGRT-4512 for bisect + repro: steps, diff, and timeline. assigning to runtime. includes links to traces and the perf script.

sara: thanks all — saving traces/samples to S3: s3://redwood-incident/4301122334/ and creating a short postmortem template.

ben: next actions: small revert PR for selector heuristics + A/B test, add unit tests for selector decision boundary, add canary guard that asserts p99 delta < 2x baseline for first 30m.

arjun: noted. moving to follow-up ticketing and postmortem.

(ended thread)
